reference: No design reference was re-opened for this component. The visual basis remains the issue 141 review (docs/evidence/issue141-cmp-preview.md) and the issue 143 re-binding (docs/evidence/issue143-cmp-preview.md). This component's implementation file is unchanged in issue 145, but its Auth variants use the shared pressed-shape animation. In issue 145 the Auth variants' pressed-shape animation source changed in `AuthActionShape.kt`: it reads its spec from the shared motion policy instead of a direct token read, with the same 220 ms `motion.shape.duration` and the easing `tween` used by default, and reduced motion snaps instead of running a zero-duration tween. `AuthActionMotionTest` is unchanged and passes, and `AuthShapeTimelineTest` compares the exact shape outline with an independent model on a manual clock. The shared `CantosTheme.kt` gained a read-only `UiPreferences.motion` projection of the existing `reducedMotion` field and a new `MotionPolicy.kt` was added; all 57 CMP capture PNGs taken before the change, including every component and logo capture and the existing Auth motion frames, are byte-identical after it (SHA-256 comparison, clean develop ff5a86aa versus the issue 145 tree). Scope and residual risk: docs/evidence/issue145-cmp-motion-policy.md.
